notes.title: Major update on February 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892537/2ac533ba9cd24542f53355a3f52f5e6e6cf6a0a2.png[/img]
Note: There will be bugs in the old archive, please restart the new game!
update content:
Added:
[b]1. Three new characters have joined Mile World.[/b]
Three new characters have been added, new skills, and new tasks.
[b]2. New CG gallery function.[/b]
Added a gallery function, players can enjoy all the CG in the game.
[b]3. Add new CG and update[/b]
We have added 100+ new CGs this time, and remade some of the original CGs
[b]4. Added Via plot missions.[/b]
The Via series of missions starts.
[b]5. Added a lot of new task content.[/b]
Continue to improve the current task plot.
[b]6. Newly added plot content of original characters.[/b]
Continue to improve the plot content of the original characters.
[b]7. Newly added maps: Outskirts of the Imperial City, Imperial Prison, Witch House, Hot Spring.[/b]
Added 4 new scenes.
[b]8. Elemental gameplay.[/b]
Elemental gameplay is now open.
[b]9. Skill remake.[/b]
We have reworked the character skills and deleted some skills.
[b]10. Increase game time system.[/b]
The time system is now enabled, and follow-up missions will be opened according to the in-game time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892537/01ea7683e0216741527f1ce4b5481de81be69425.png[/img]
Adjustment:
1. Damage value adjustment: We have reworked the damage value.
2. Dialogue can now be quickly skipped: hold down the Enter key or the left mouse button to quickly skip the dialogue,
3. Treasure chests and other items can be opened multiple times at a time: the multi-opening mode of treasure chests and other items has been added.
4. Adjusted the battle speed: We have accelerated the speed of the battle
5. Optimized the FPS synchronization function and solved problems such as stuttering
6. Skill learning adjustment, player's skill upgrade is more convenient and quick
7. Part of the character CG has been remade
8. The guild has added a portal to quickly travel to the wild
9. Added event NPC. Part of the event can be accessed by NPC.
10. The Christmas map will be adjusted to open from November to January in the game
11. Repair known bugs
PS: Due to the large update content, the original archive will have errors, it is recommended to open a new file
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892537/e439e1fbe9c3b7d60273ff7d38e2d21c352c8467.png[/img]
